# FieldError

The message that opens under a field. `TextField`, `SelectField` and `Combobox` include it; use it directly under a control of your own.

[Live demo](https://gurfi1.github.io/react-shopify-style-checkout/#/components/fielderror)

## Usage

```tsx
<FieldError id="err-email" message={error} />
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `message` | `string \| null` | The text. Empty closes the row; the last message stays visible while it closes. |
| `id` | `string` | Point the control’s aria-describedby at it. |

## Files

To use this on its own, copy this folder:

- `FieldError.module.css`
- `FieldError.tsx`

It also needs:

- [`src/utils.ts`](../../utils.ts)

Everything expects a [`Theme`](../../theme) somewhere above it, which supplies the colours, corners and timings.
